def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("all input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar and not a boolean")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    def loss(logp):
        return -np.dot(logp, norm_weights)  # shape (n_candidates,)

    L_with_result = loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = loss(logp_no_call)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Keep calls meeting threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margin
